consent.title: Consent to AI processing
consent.what: For the summary, the WWHealth server sends Google Gemini only minimal facts from your record: age, sex, blood type, allergies, conditions, medication, surgeries, document titles and dates, and confirmed lab values.
consent.notSent: Your name, email, date of birth, document files and their full text are not sent. Prompts are not written to logs.
consent.storage: Only the latest summary is kept, so you can see when it was generated. You can delete it anytime; withdrawing consent deletes it immediately.
consent.revokeMessage: Nothing more is sent to Gemini and the saved summary is deleted, for doctors too.

lungvision.text: An experimental model (DenseNet121) that analyses chest X-rays and highlights the areas it looked at (Grad-CAM). The result is informative, not a diagnosis.

care.emergencyNote: In an emergency (chest pain, can't breathe, stroke signs, fainting), call 112.
care.describeHint: Type or dictate: what you feel, since when, where. You can edit the text before sending it.
care.placeholder: E.g. I have been coughing for two weeks, mostly at night…

voice.title: Dictate your symptoms
voice.consentText: The audio recording is sent to ElevenLabs only to transcribe it. You check the text; nothing is saved.
voice.consentLabel: I agree that the recording is sent to ElevenLabs
voice.demo: Demo mode: example text, not what you said. Check it before sending.

care.confirmLabel: I checked the text and confirm it
care.confirmHint: Only the confirmed text is used for the recommendation.
care.confirmHintVoice: Check the transcript and fix anything that was misheard.
care.historyHint: Optional: active conditions, allergies and active medication (no name or identifying data).

consent.title: Consent to AI processing (Gemini)
consent.text: For the specialty recommendation, the confirmed text (and your history, if you choose) is sent to Gemini. It is the same consent as for the AI summary; you can withdraw it anytime in AI Insights.
consent.withoutIt: Without consent the emergency rules still work and you can search any specialty manually.

care.confirmFirst: Confirm the text above to send it.
care.failedTitle: The recommendation could not be generated

emergency.callText: What you described may be an emergency. Don't wait for an appointment: call 112 or go to the nearest emergency department right away.
emergency.urgentText: Some symptoms need a doctor the same day. If they get worse, call 112. The suggestions below do not replace urgent care.
emergency.rulesNote: Message from fixed safety rules, not from AI.

status_noConsent.title: No AI consent
status_noConsent.text: Nothing was sent to Gemini. Give consent above or search a specialty manually.

status_notConfigured.title: AI is not configured on the server
status_notConfigured.text: The AI recommendation is not available right now. You can search any specialty and book directly.

status_failed.title: AI unavailable right now
status_failed.text: Gemini did not answer. Try again later or search a specialty manually.

result.title: Suggested specialties
result.subtitle: From the WWHealth catalog. You choose where to book.
result.historyUsed: Data from your WWHealth history was used too.
result.questionsHint: Answer only what you know; the recommendation is updated.
result.warningTitle: When to go to the emergency department
result.discarded_one: {{count}} AI statement was removed (it broke the safety rules).
result.discarded_other: {{count}} AI statements were removed (they broke the safety rules).
result.disclaimer: Experimental AI suggestion, for information only. It is not a diagnosis, does not rate severity and does not recommend treatment.

search.intro: Search any specialty, no AI involved.
search.noneHint: Try another word or choose Family medicine.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.intro: Verified WWHealth doctors with their free slots in the next 14 days.
doctors.noSlotsTitle: {{name}} doctors have no free slots in the next 14 days
doctors.noneText: You can choose another specialty or a family doctor, who can refer you further.
doctors.noSlots: No free slots in the next 14 days

book.slotsHint: Only free slots from the doctor's calendar.
book.noteHint: Don't write anything you don't want the doctor to see. Up to 500 characters.
book.sentText: The doctor can accept it, reject it or propose another time. See the answer in My appointments.

appointments.emptyHint: Describe your symptoms in Smart Care or search a specialty directly.
appointments.cancelText: The slot becomes free again for other patients.

doctor.entryHint: Patient requests and your free slots.
doctor.noRequestsHint: Publish free slots in Availability so patients can book you.
doctor.rejectText: The patient will see the request was rejected and can look for another doctor.
doctor.privacy: You see only the patient's name and message. Their record stays available only with their consent (Transfer & Access).
doctor.proposeHint: Choose a free slot from your calendar:
doctor.noFreeSlots: You have no free slots. Add some in Availability.
doctor.mySlotsHint: Tap a slot to delete it. Booked ones stay valid for the patient.
doctor.noSlotsHint: Patients see you in search only when you have free slots.

failure.timeout: Gemini did not answer in time. Try again.
failure.busy: Gemini is overloaded right now (we retried automatically). Try again in a minute.
failure.invalid: Gemini sent an answer that does not match the required format, so it was not shown. Try again.
failure.error: Gemini refused the request. Try again; if it keeps happening, check GEMINI_API_KEY and the model in backend/.env.
